description: Deterministic Offline Emergency Rules for Medora Rural Health

rules.title: Severe Respiratory Distress / Acute Airway Compromise
redFlags: Acute respiratory failure or severe airway obstruction detected.
Patient experiencing severe hypoxemia risk or inability to maintain adequate ventilation.
rules.actionGuidance: Immediate 108 Emergency Ambulance dispatch required. Keep patient sitting upright in high-Fowler position. Loosen tight neck and chest clothing. Do not give oral solids or fluids while gasping.

rules.title: Acute Coronary Syndrome / Crushing Chest Pain

hi: सीने में भारीपन बाएं हाथ में दर्द

redFlags: High risk of acute myocardial infarction (heart attack).
Severe crushing chest pain radiating to arm, neck, or jaw with diaphoresis or dyspnea.
rules.actionGuidance: Call 108 immediately. Have patient rest completely in a seated position. Avoid any exertion or walking. Keep emergency medical services en route.

rules.title: Loss of Consciousness / Unresponsiveness / Coma
redFlags: Unresponsive patient with impaired neurological state.
Risk of airway compromise and aspiration.
rules.actionGuidance: Check pulse and normal breathing. Place in recovery position (lateral decubitus) to keep airway open if breathing. Call 108 immediately. Do not pour water into mouth.

rules.title: Hemorrhage / Severe Uncontrolled Bleeding / Hematemesis

hi: बहुत ज्यादा खून बह रहा है

redFlags: Active hypovolemic shock risk due to heavy external or internal bleeding.
rules.actionGuidance: Apply firm direct continuous pressure with a clean cloth. Elevate injured extremity if safe. Call 108 emergency transport immediately.

rules.title: Acute Stroke / FAST Signs / Sudden Paralysis
redFlags: Acute focal neurological deficit suggestive of ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke (FAST).
rules.actionGuidance: Time is brain. Record exact time of symptom onset. Call 108 ambulance immediately for emergency CT-capable hospital transfer.

rules.title: Active Convulsions / Status Epilepticus / Fits
redFlags: Active generalized motor seizure or repetitive seizures without regaining consciousness.
rules.actionGuidance: Clear surrounding sharp objects. Protect head with cushion. Do NOT put any metal keys, spoon, or fingers into the mouth. Turn to side once spasms stop. Call 108.

rules.title: Anaphylaxis / Severe Systemic Allergic Reaction

hi: जीभ में भारी सूजन सांस बंद

redFlags: Anaphylactic shock risk with rapid airway swelling and circulatory collapse.
rules.actionGuidance: Inject epinephrine auto-injector if available. Call 108 immediately. Keep patient flat with legs elevated unless breathing is easier sitting.

rules.title: Severe Self-Harm / Crisis Red Flag
redFlags: Immediate danger to life from intentional poisoning, overdose, or acute self-harm crisis.
rules.actionGuidance: Immediate emergency care required. Call 108 ambulance. Call National Mental Health Helpline Tele-MANAS at 14416 or 1800-891-4416. If poison consumed, take the container to the hospital.
